#include "pic_p.h"

#include <QImage>
#include <QDataStream>
#include <QDebug>

#include "rle_p.h"

namespace   // Private.
{

// Header format of saved files.
const quint32 picMagic = 0x01234567;

struct PicHeader {
    quint32 Magic;
    quint32 FileSize;
    quint32 FileType;
    quint32 Width;
    quint32 Height;
    quint32 Depth;
    quint32 ColorMap;
    quint32 Reserved;
    enum { SIZE = 32 }; // 8 fields of four bytes each
};

static QDataStream &operator>> (QDataStream &s, PicHeader &head)
{
    s >> head.Magic;
    s >> head.FileSize;
    s >> head.FileType;
    s >> head.Width;
    s >> head.Height;
    s >> head.Depth;
    s >> head.ColorMap;
    s >> head.Reserved;
    return s;
}

static bool IsSupported(const PicHeader &head)
{
    if (head.Magic != picMagic) {
        return false;
    }
    if (head.Width == 0 || head.Height == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    if (head.Depth != 8 && head.Depth != 24 && head.Depth != 32) {
        return false;
    }
    if (head.FileType != 1) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool LoadPIC(QDataStream &s, const PicHeader &pic, QImage &img)
{
    // Read palette if needed.
    QVector<QRgb> colorTable;
    if (pic.ColorMap) {
        // skip colormap
        s.skipRawData(pic.ColorMap);
    }

    // Create image.
    if (pic.Depth == 8) {
        img = QImage(pic.Width, pic.Height, QImage::Format_Indexed8);
        img.setColorCount(256);
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            img.setColor(i, qRgb(i, i, i));
        }
    } else {
        img = QImage(pic.Width, pic.Height, QImage::Format_RGB32);
    }

    if (img.isNull()) {
        return false;
    }

    // Read lines.
    if (pic.Depth == 8) {
        for (quint32 y = 0; y < pic.Height; y++) {
            uchar *scanline = img.scanLine(y);
            bool success = decodeRLEData(RLEVariant::PIC, s,
                                         scanline, pic.Width,
                                         [](QDataStream &stream) -> uchar {
                                             uchar pixel;
                                             stream >> pixel;
                                             return pixel;
                                         },
                                         [](uchar, uchar pixel) -> uchar {
                                             return pixel;
                                         });
            if (!success) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    } else if (pic.Depth == 24) {
        for (quint32 y = 0; y < pic.Height; y++) {
            QRgb *scanline = reinterpret_cast<QRgb *>(img.scanLine(y));
            bool success = decodeRLEData(RLEVariant::PIC, s,
                                         scanline, pic.Width,
                                         [](QDataStream &stream) -> QRgb {
                                             uchar r, g, b;
                                             stream >> r >> g >> b;
                                             return qRgb(r, g, b);
                                         },
                                         [](QRgb, QRgb pixel) -> QRgb {
                                             return pixel;
                                         });
            if (!success) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    } else if (pic.Depth == 32) {
        for (quint32 y = 0; y < pic.Height; y++) {
            QRgb *scanline = reinterpret_cast<QRgb *>(img.scanLine(y));
            bool success = decodeRLEData(RLEVariant::PIC, s,
                                         scanline, pic.Width,
                                         [](QDataStream &stream) -> QRgb {
                                             uchar r, g, b, a;
                                             stream >> r >> g >> b >> a;
                                             return qRgba(r, g, b, a);
                                         },
                                         [](QRgb, QRgb pixel) -> QRgb {
                                             return pixel;
                                         });
            if (!success) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}

} // Private

PICHandler::PICHandler()
{
}

bool PICHandler::canRead() const
{
    if (canRead(device())) {
        setFormat("pic");
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PICHandler::canRead(QIODevice *device)
{
    if (!device) {
        qWarning("PICHandler::canRead() called with no device");
        return false;
    }

    if (device->isSequential()) {
        // qWarning("Reading pic files from sequential devices not supported");
        return false;
    }

    qint64 oldPos = device->pos();
    QByteArray head = device->read(PicHeader::SIZE); // header is exactly 32 bytes, always
    int readBytes = head.size(); // this should always be 32 bytes

    device->seek(oldPos);

    if (readBytes < PicHeader::SIZE) {
        return false;
    }

    QDataStream stream(head);
    stream.setByteOrder(QDataStream::BigEndian);
    PicHeader pic;
    stream >> pic;
    return IsSupported(pic);
}

bool PICHandler::read(QImage *outImage)
{
    QDataStream s(device());
    s.setByteOrder(QDataStream::BigEndian);

    // Read image header.
    PicHeader pic;
    s >> pic;

    // Check supported file types.
    if (!IsSupported(pic)) {
//         qDebug() << "This PIC file is not supported.";
        return false;
    }

    QImage img;
    bool result = LoadPIC(s, pic, img);

    if (result == false) {
//         qDebug() << "Error loading PIC file.";
        return false;
    }

    *outImage = img;
    return true;
}

QImageIOPlugin::Capabilities PICPlugin::capabilities(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format) const
{
    if (format == "pic") {
        return Capabilities(CanRead);
    }
    if (!format.isEmpty()) {
        return {};
    }
    if (!device->isOpen()) {
        return {};
    }

    Capabilities cap;
    if (device->isReadable() && PICHandler::canRead(device)) {
        cap |= CanRead;
    }
    return cap;
}

QImageIOHandler *PICPlugin::create(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format) const
{
    QImageIOHandler *handler = new PICHandler;
    handler->setDevice(device);
    handler->setFormat(format);
    return handler;
}

}

bool EPSHandler::canRead() const
{
    if (canRead(device())) {
        setFormat("eps");
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool EPSHandler::canRead(QIODevice *device)
{
    if (!device) {
        qWarning("EPSHandler::canRead() called with no device");
        return false;
    }

    if (device->isSequential()) {
        // qWarning("Reading eps files from sequential devices not supported");
        return false;
    }

    qint64 oldPos = device->pos();
    QByteArray head = device->read(EpsHeader::SIZE); // header is exactly 32 bytes, always
    int readBytes = head.size(); // this should always be 32 bytes

    device->seek(oldPos);

    if (readBytes < EpsHeader::SIZE) {
        return false;
    }

    QDataStream stream(head);
    stream.setByteOrder(QDataStream::BigEndian);
    EpsHeader eps;
    stream >> eps;
    return IsSupported(eps);
}

bool EPSHandler::read(QImage *outImage)
{
    QDataStream s(device());
    s.setByteOrder(QDataStream::BigEndian);

    // Read image header.
    EpsHeader eps;
    s >> eps;

    // Check supported file types.
    if (!IsSupported(eps)) {
//         qDebug() << "This EPS file is not supported.";
        return false;
    }

    QImage img;
    bool result = LoadEPS(s, eps, img);

    if (result == false) {
//         qDebug() << "Error loading EPS file.";
        return false;
    }

    *outImage = img;
    return true;
}

QImageIOPlugin::Capabilities EPSPlugin::capabilities(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format) const
{
    if (format == "eps") {
        return Capabilities(CanRead);
    }
    if (!format.isEmpty()) {
        return {};
    }
    if (!device->isOpen()) {
        return {};
    }

    Capabilities cap;
    if (device->isReadable() && EPSHandler::canRead(device)) {
        cap |= CanRead;
    }
    return cap;
}

QImageIOHandler *EPSPlugin::create(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format) const
{
    QImageIOHandler *handler = new EPSHandler;
    handler->setDevice(device);
    handler->setFormat(format);
    return handler;
}
